title: Spire2 Pile Viewer
description:
See your teammates' draw, exhaust, and discard piles in co-op.

[list]
[*] A strip with live pile counts hovers above each teammate during combat, using the game's own pile icons.
[*] [b]Click[/b] a slot to open that pile in the game's card-pile screen (click again to close).
[*] [b]Shift+drag[/b] a strip to move it; each teammate's strip remembers its own spot.
[*] [b]Hotkeys[/b] (rebindable): teammate 1 Shift+Z / Shift+V / Shift+C (draw / exhaust / discard), teammate 2 Ctrl+..., teammate 3 Ctrl+Shift+.... The game's own hotkeys, the dev console, and text fields take precedence.
[*] [b]F1[/b] settings: show/hide, size, background opacity, a strip over your own character, text-list mode, hotkey rebinding, reset positions.
[*] Works with 2-4 players. Display only - doesn't change gameplay.
[/list]

Source: https://github.com/hanryhu/Spire2PileViewer
Architecture adapted from BetterSpire2 by jdr.
